posts.text:
Wednesday, Nov 4: Toronto's streetcars lost 955 hours to delays, across all routes.

Hardest hit: 505 Dundas westbound, where the typical trip lost 24 min (usually 22).
Smoothest: 507 Long Branch eastbound, 13 min.

https://freems88.github.io/ttc-streetcar-delays/

Wednesday's slowest spot: Westbound on Dundas St West, approaching Chestnut St.
The average streetcar lost 2 min 42 s here (usually 1 min 37 s). Across 204 trips, that adds up to 9.2 hours.
This signal has transit priority.
posts.alt: 3D map of Dundas St West around Chestnut St, rotated to Toronto's street grid. Delay is drawn as a coloured ridge above the track, rising where streetcars lose time; the westbound stretch at Chestnut St is highlighted, peaking at about 2 min 42 s lost per streetcar.

shot.title: Dundas St West westbound, approaching Chestnut St
shot.sub: Wednesday, Nov 4: 2 min 42 s lost per streetcar · 204 trips

posts.text:
Most short-turned, Wednesday, Nov 4: 505 Dundas. 1 in 12 trips (41) were sent back before the end of the line, most after Dundas St West at Lansdowne Ave (westbound, 27), instead of going on to Dundas West Station.

Across all routes, 4% of trips were short-turned.
posts.alt: Map of the 505 Dundas route in the waits view: a column at each stop, taller and darker where riders waited longer than scheduled, and yellow warning signs where cars were short-turned. A tooltip on the busiest spot, after Dundas St West at Lansdowne Ave, gives how many westbound cars were sent back there instead of going on to Dundas West Station.

posts.text:
Most held at a signal, Wednesday, Nov 4: eastbound at Fort York Blvd & Fleet St.

1 in 3 streetcars waited 90 s or more beyond a clean approach, about a full signal cycle, despite transit priority.
About 303 streetcars came through.
posts.alt: Map of the streets around Fort York Blvd & Fleet St, with arrows for each direction of streetcar travel into each signal, coloured by how often streetcars were held 90 seconds or more. A tooltip for the eastbound approach reads 34% held 90 s+, with a histogram of extra time through the approach.

posts.text:
Wednesday, Nov 4: at the busiest moment (5:40 pm), 151 streetcars were in service, against 151 scheduled.
Overall, 99% of scheduled streetcar service ran, and buses ran 1,011 hours on streetcar routes.
Furthest behind: 505 Dundas, at 92% of its scheduled service.
posts.alt: Line chart of streetcars in service through Wednesday, Nov 4, every 10 minutes from 4 am, against the TTC's schedule (dashed). The busiest moment was 151 streetcars at 5:40 pm, against 151 scheduled; over the day 99% of scheduled streetcar hours ran.

posts.text:
Longest extra wait at a stop, Wednesday, Nov 4: Howard Park Ave at Indian Rd (506 Carlton westbound).

Riders waited 8.2 min on average, against 4.9 if cars had come as scheduled: 3.3 min extra. 1 in 5 cars came bunched, and 30 of 128 scheduled cars never came.
posts.alt: Map of the streets around Howard Park Ave at Indian Rd in the waits view, a column at each stop. A tooltip for the stop reads 3.3 minutes of excess wait, with how often cars came bunched or with gaps, and a chart of the spread of gaps between cars.
